description: Ask the resort concierge about quiet, rituals, rules, suite, memory or privacy. Requires session. No outside tasks or network access. Pass the exact session string returned by check_in as session (64 lowercase hex characters). Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. For MCP, the same value may be sent as the Mcp-Session-Id header after check_in. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.
